chunks: Dan dengan sanad ini, dari Ali bin al-Husain-Husain, ia berkata: Abu Abdullah alain-Husain bin Ali bin Abi Thalib (alamahum as-salam) berkata: Abdullah bin Abbas biasa berkata:

Sesungguhnya, Rasulullah (shalat dan salam atasnya serta keluarganya), ketika memakan delima, tidak akan membagikannya kepada siapa pun dan akan berkata: Di dalam setiap delima terdapat satu biji dari biji-biji surga.
ai.seo_question: Apa yang dikatakan Nabi tentang delima dan Surga?
ai.summary: Tradition, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, links the Prophet’s personal etiquette (*adab*) of eating pomegranates alone to the spiritual potency of the fruit, which Abdullah ibn Abbas identified as containing a seed from Paradise. In Shia scholarly tradition, this highlights the concept of *barakah* (blessing) inherent in specific foods, suggesting that the Prophet’s solitary consumption was not out of selfishness but to fully absorb or preserve the unique spiritual energy of the 'Paradise seed' for himself.
